subject.title: fix(agents): clear recovery residue on sessions without a recorded status

question: Should this maintainer-labeled session-state repair merge after a redacted after-fix recovery transcript, or is the production row evidence plus focused regression coverage sufficient for this exceptional case?
rationale: The code path deletes persisted recovery ownership state, and the supplied production evidence describes the pre-fix failure rather than the observed post-fix result.

options.title: Require one after-fix recovery proof

options.title: Accept the focused source and regression evidence
options.body: Land based on the documented production row shape and focused test coverage, accepting that the first deployed recovery is the operational confirmation.
